dialog.newDescription: Create a new collection to organize your requests.
dialog.baseUrlHint: Prepended to request paths that start with /. A folder-level Base URL overrides the parent collection's value for requests inside this folder.

request.deleteDescription: "{{name}}" will be deleted. This action cannot be undone.

join.title: Join Collection
join.description: Enter a share code to join a collection and start collaborating.
join.requiresAccount: Collection sharing requires a PatchMan account. Sign in and reopen this link.

share.title: Share Collection
share.description: Make "{{name}}" discoverable to teams or everyone with the Public toggle, or invite specific people with a share code below.
share.deprecatedInfo: Share codes are kept for backwards compatibility and will be removed in a future release. Not recommended — for new shares, flip the Public toggle above and add specific users, teams, or Everyone to the Editors / Viewers lists. That surface gives you finer-grained roles and integrates with the workspace + team binding model.
share.shareHint: Share this code with others. They can use "Join Collection" to collaborate.
share.linkHint: Recipients click the link, sign in if needed, and join automatically.
share.revokeHint: Removes all access and invalidates the share code.
share.inviteesHint: Invitees appear here once they use the share code.

push.title: Push to GitLab
push.descriptionBound: Send local edits in "{{name}}" back to {{project}} as a merge request.
push.descriptionUnbound: Send local edits in "{{name}}" back to GitLab.
push.pushingDesc: Patching the source file and pushing back.
push.notBound: This collection is not bound to a GitLab file. Use Import → GitLab to bring it in.
push.noChanges: No changes between local edits and the remote file.

tree.refreshingDesc: Fetching the spec and re-syncing requests.
tree.noLongerAccess: You no longer have access to "{{name}}".
tree.cascadeLeaveInfo: Access comes from a shared workspace — you can't leave this collection on its own. To drop access, ask the workspace owner to remove you from the team or unbind the workspace.
tree.deleteDescription: "{{name}}" and all its requests will be deleted. This action cannot be undone.
tree.leaveDescription: You will lose access to "{{name}}". The owner{{ownerSuffix}} keeps the collection and can re-invite you later.
tree.collectionsElsewhereOne: You have {{count}} collection in other workspaces.
tree.collectionsElsewhereOther: You have {{count}} collections in other workspaces.
tree.createHint: Create a collection to organize your requests

accordion.nothingPublic: Nothing public yet. Make a collection public from its Share menu, or wait for someone to share one with you.
accordion.accessViaGrant: You have access via a team or everyone grant — ask the owner to remove that grant if you want to drop access.
accordion.somethingWrong: Something went wrong — please try again.
accordion.deleteConfirmDescription: This deletes the collection for everyone — public grants and individual collaborators lose access. This action cannot be undone.

import.title: Import Collection
import.description: Drop a PatchMan, Postman, or OpenAPI file — format is detected automatically. Or pull a Postman collection straight from a GitLab repo.
import.urlPlaceholder: OpenAPI JSON URL or Scalar / Swagger UI / Redoc page
import.urlHint: Direct openapi.json works, and so do live docs pages — we'll scrape the embedded spec URL or probe well-known paths.
import.filesReadyOne: {{count}} file ready · drop more to append
import.filesReadyOther: {{count}} files ready · drop more to append
import.wsdlNeedsBackend: WSDL import needs the hosted backend (not available in local mode).
import.couldNotDetect: Could not detect format. Pick one from the dropdown and retry.
import.probing: Probing the URL — direct JSON, Scalar, Swagger UI, or Redoc page.
import.pasteGitlabUrl: Paste the GitLab file URL (the /-/blob/ or /-/raw/ link).
import.dropOrPaste: Drop a file, paste JSON, or enter a URL.
import.gitlabSignIn: Sign in to PatchMan to use the GitLab integration. Local mode is offline-only.
import.connectGitlabTitle: Connect GitLab to import from a repo
import.connectGitlabDesc: One-time link with your GitLab account. After approving, this view updates automatically.
import.gitlabUrlHint: Paste the GitLab file URL (works with both /-/blob/ and /-/raw/ links). Branch must be the first path segment; slash-bearing branch names are not supported yet.
